issue: `add_business_days(start, n)` returns weekend dates: adding 1 business day to Friday 2026-01-02 gives Saturday instead of Monday 2026-01-05. Saturdays and Sundays never count, n=0 on a weekend returns the date unchanged, and negative n goes backwards.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

`add_business_days(start, n)` returns weekend dates: adding 1 business day to Friday 2026-01-02 gives Saturday instead of Monday 2026-01-05. Saturdays and Sundays never count, n=0 on a weekend returns the date unchanged, and negative n goes backwards.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q`. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
